NOTE
**Still not ready: the earlier PR is still open and claimed by a maintainer**

New: Nothing since the feedback. There is no new push, and the author only asked again after updating the description to credit the earlier PR. Missing: Nobody has confirmed that the earlier PR (#37289) is abandoned, even though it is open and assigned to @prakhar1144, who said on 2026-09-04 he plans to finish it. There are also no dark-theme screenshots, which the issue asks for and which were requested on the earlier PR.

###### Next step

Keep "not ready", and loop in prakhar1144 (assigned on #37289) to say whether this PR should replace that one.

###### Reply

```quote
Thanks for updating the description! #37289 is still open and assigned to @prakhar1144, who plans to finish it, so please check with him and @CerealNotFound that taking it over is fine, as the [continuing unfinished work guide](https://zulip.readthedocs.io/en/latest/contributing/continuing-unfinished-work.html) describes. Please also add dark-theme screenshots of the header bars.
```
